title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 09:22:58 最新章节：第两千四百零七章 紫萱表态
content_zh:
“各位观众，你们好！
我是‘尘世美不美’节目的主持人紫萱。
今天我们尘世美不美的主题是‘80后的现实与理想’，节目组通过网络报名和微信推荐，我们最终选取了几个在现实生活中具有一定代表性的人物，这些人物不是明星、也不是名人，而是实实在在、普普通通的人。
让我们从这几位的经历和对未来展望的讲述中，看看能得到什么样的启示。
按照我们的主题，我们在这个节目播出前是征求了出镜者的同意，做了相当详细的资料搜集的，也许本人都没留意的细节我们都找到了的。
好，今天是第一期，今天出镜的，是一位叫林凡的男士，现在有请林凡上场！”
我在幕后焦虑不安的等着，幕后的一切都让我如此的陌生，忙碌的工作人员在穿插着工作，少言少语。
我透过挡板看着聚光灯最强烈的地方，是在整个录播场地的中央，有两张看上去十分舒适的沙发，还有一张作为衬托的茶几，上面有个花瓶，插了一束洋甘菊，还有菊花和非洲菊，洋甘菊的白、菊花的黄和非洲菊的橙，这个搭配有点奇怪的感觉，我看了一眼这三种花的搭配，便明白了节目组的意思，我对花语有印象，洋甘菊的花语是越挫越勇、苦难中的力量，菊花的花语是逆境中的乐观心态，非洲菊的花语是感叹、永远快乐。
这个看上去小小的方寸之地，就是待会儿我要去出镜的地方。
场务在接到信号后，对我说：“你现在可以上场了。”
然后轻轻地推了我一把，“朝这儿走出去。”
他指着我正前方。
我还没有试过从一个暗黑的地方走出来直接就暴露在聚光灯下的经验，双手有点不知所措，好像有点发紧抽筋似的，努力的想笑得自然一点，不过我自己都感觉脸部拘谨得像刚铺设没多久就快干了的水泥地面。
刚走到聚光灯的范围内，也就是摄像机能照射过来的范围，我感觉三台摄像机似乎齐刷刷的对准了我。
“请到这里来，请坐！”
紫萱朝我做了个邀请的手势。
她在镜头前是如此的干练自信，和我的拘谨形成鲜明的对比，我暗自佩服她，我最缺乏的就是在大的场合里的应该展示的自信，平时在我的生活和工作里，似乎不缺乏这种自信，但是到了某种陌生的环境里，我便感觉到了我的拘谨原来是深深的植根在内心深处，那种本以为我可以从容应对的场合却成了抄家现场，一群陌生的人甚至是一个陌生的人，只是用眼神，就能将我的不自信从内心最深处用意念翻箱倒柜般的倾泻在这聚光灯下。
我脚步略僵硬的朝紫萱走了过去，脸上带着赊购回来的笑容，这种笑容，为了这来之不易的出镜，我突击看了很多访谈节目，对着镜子模仿了很多宾客的笑容，我尤其想学的是李连杰接受访谈时双手做了个大环状那时候自信的笑容，虽然他那个动作在网上被改成了很多段子的配图。
对各种值得学习的事物，不存在年龄上的隔断。
想到这里，我暗自深呼吸了一口气，在紫萱的指定的沙发坐了下来，沙发很软很舒适，电视台真会挑赞助商的产品，如果这张沙发不是在录播现场，而是在自己家的阳台上、幻想中的山林小屋二楼露天的阳台上或者海边酒店高层的阳台上，我想我会在一杯冰镇可乐的陪伴下很惬意的昏昏欲睡而不睡，这种状态才是最人间、也是最仙境的。

不知道为什么我喜欢阳台，每个我幻想的场景中，都少不了阳台的存在，或者弗洛伊德的理论可以解释我为什么喜欢阳台，不过这老家伙的理论和我们的社会常规价值观有着太大的差距，说不定哪天还真的会成为禁书了，极端一点就反过来了，奉为圭臬。
“你好！
请自我介绍一下。”
紫萱依然是那种我的地盘我是主人的语气，我略微不喜欢这种类似命令式的语气，但我羡慕，这种羡慕在心里，这次让谁翻箱倒柜都不让找到的地方，我在心里上了个密码锁。
听到紫萱要求我自我介绍后，按照事前的彩排，我得一口气自报家名，还要立马很自然的口吻说出一件事来作为今天主题的引子给主持人做铺垫，然后她会故作惊讶的将这个话题引申下去。
“我叫林凡，树林的林，平凡的凡。
这个名字是有含义的，因为姓和名加起来就是梵，清净、寂静的意思。”
“嗯，这个名字的组合含义有意思，有点像香港的填词人林夕，林加夕，就是梦的意思。”
紫萱在镜头前侃侃而谈。
按照彩排约定，我必须配合接她的话题：“是的，大概是这个意思。”
我停了一下，心里觉得立刻缓和了许多，这个主持人还不是花瓶，还是有点主持功架的，在我偶尔看电视看到她的主持时候，总觉得她的主持内容都是幕后工作人员替她全部打理好的，这次我有幸被抽中参与这个节目后，我亲眼看着她台前幕后的忙碌，一字一句的在对稿，还经常独自一个人对着全身落地镜在练习台型。
只是我怎么都想不到，日后我的经历，竟然与她有莫大的关系，似乎就是冥冥中注定的，原来，生活才是自己的导演。
我接着说：“我爸说我出生在1979年12月31日23点59分，我妈每次一听到我爸这样说，就数落我爸你知道个啥？她说我是1980年1月1日0点0分出生的，是那一天本市第一个出生的宝宝。
我出来工作后曾经问过她为什么这么执着于这一分钟，是不是因为我是第一个出生的，当时的电视台或报纸有报道？她说是，但是，是因为那一天报纸刊登的本市第一个出生的宝宝是0点3分出生的，并不是我，而是一个家里在本市有点权势的人的孩子。
我说所以你耿耿于怀？我妈说是的，不是为了所谓的第一，而是要还原真实。
content_en:
"Hello, viewers!
I am Zixuan, the host of the program "Is the World Beautiful?"
Today, the theme of our worldly beauty is ‘Reality and Ideals of the Post-80s Generation’. Through online registration and WeChat recommendations, the program team finally selected a few representative figures in real life. These figures are not stars or celebrities, but real, ordinary people.
Let us see what kind of inspiration we can get from these people’s experiences and future prospects.
In accordance with our theme, we sought the consent of the people who appeared on the show before broadcasting it and did a fairly detailed collection of information. We may have found details that we may not have noticed.
Okay, today is the first episode. Today’s appearance is a man named Lin Fan. Now we invite Lin Fan to appear! "
I waited anxiously behind the scenes. Everything behind the scenes felt so strange to me. The busy staff were busy with their work and spoke little.
I looked through the baffle to the spot where the spotlight was strongest. It was in the center of the entire recording venue. There were two very comfortable-looking sofas, and a coffee table as a foil. There was a vase on it with a bunch of chamomiles, chrysanthemums and gerberas, white chamomile, yellow chrysanthemum and gerbera. Orange, this combination feels a bit strange. I took a look at the combination of these three flowers and understood the meaning of the program team. I have an impression of the language of flowers. The flower language of chamomile is courage and strength in suffering, the flower language of chrysanthemum is optimism in adversity, and the flower language of gerbera is sigh and eternal happiness.
This seemingly small place is where I will be photographed later.
After receiving the signal, the field steward said to me: "You can play now."
Then he gave me a gentle push and said, "Go out here."
He pointed directly in front of me.
I have never had the experience of coming out of a dark place and being directly exposed to the spotlight. My hands were a little overwhelmed, as if they were tight and cramped. I tried hard to smile more naturally, but my face felt as restrained as a cement floor that was almost drying just after it was laid.
As soon as I walked within the range of the spotlight, which is the range that the camera can shine on, I felt that three cameras seemed to be pointed at me.
"Please come here and have a seat!"
Zixuan made an inviting gesture toward me.
She is so capable and confident in front of the camera, which is in sharp contrast to my restraint. I secretly admire her. What I lack most is the self-confidence that should be shown in big occasions. In my life and work, I don't seem to lack this kind of self-confidence, but when I am in a strange environment, I feel It turned out that my restraint was deeply rooted in my heart. The situation that I thought I could handle calmly turned out to be the scene of a house raid. A group of strangers or even a stranger could pour out my unconfidence from the deepest part of my heart into the spotlight with just my eyes.
I walked towards Zixuan with slightly stiff steps, with a smile on my face that I bought on credit. In order to get this hard-won appearance, I watched a lot of talk shows and imitated the smiles of many guests in the mirror. What I especially wanted to imitate was Jet Li's confident smile when he made a big ring with his hands during the interview, although his action has been changed into a picture of many jokes on the Internet.
There is no age barrier to all things worth learning.
Thinking of this, I secretly took a deep breath and sat down on the sofa designated by Zixuan. The sofa is very soft and comfortable. The TV station really knows how to choose products from sponsors. If this sofa was not at the recording site, but on the balcony of my own home, the open-air balcony on the second floor of a fantasy lodge or the balcony of a high-rise beach hotel, I think I would be accompanied by a glass of iced Coke.It is very comfortable to be drowsy without falling asleep. This state is the most human and the most fairyland.
I don’t know why I like balconies. Balconies are indispensable in every fantasy scene I have. Perhaps Freud’s theory can explain why I like balconies. However, there is a big gap between this old guy’s theory and the conventional values ​​of our society. Maybe one day it will really become a banned book. If it is extreme, it will be the other way around and be regarded as a guideline.
"Hello!
Please introduce yourself. "
Zixuan still has the tone of "I am the master of my territory". I slightly dislike this command-like tone, but I am envious. This kind of envy is in my heart. This time, I put a code lock in my heart to prevent anyone from rummaging through the cabinets to find the place.
After hearing Zixuan ask me to introduce myself, according to the rehearsal beforehand, I had to introduce my family name in one breath, and immediately say one thing in a natural tone to serve as an introduction to today's topic to pave the way for the host, and then she would pretend to be surprised and expand on the topic.
"My name is Lin Fan, Lin from the woods, ordinary Fan.
This name has meaning, because the surname and first name combined are Brahman, which means purity and silence. "
"Well, the combination of this name has an interesting meaning. It's a bit like the Hong Kong lyricist Lin Xi. Lin Jiaxi means dream."
Zixuan chatted in front of the camera.
According to the rehearsal agreement, I had to cooperate in picking up her topic: "Yes, that's about it."
I paused for a moment, and I immediately felt relieved. This host is not a flower vase, but she still has some hosting skills. When I occasionally watch her hosting on TV, I always feel that her hosting content is all taken care of by the staff behind the scenes. After I was lucky enough to be selected to participate in this program, I saw with my own eyes how busy she was in front of and behind the scenes. She was correcting the script word for word, and she often practiced her posture alone in front of the full-length mirror.
But I never imagined that my future experiences would be closely related to her. It seemed to be destined. It turns out that life is my own director.
I continued: "My father said that I was born at 23:59 on December 31, 1979. Every time my mother heard my father say this, she scolded my father. What do you know? She said that I was born at 0:00 on January 1, 1980, and I was the first baby born in this city on that day.
After I came out to work, I once asked her why she was so obsessed with this minute. Was it because I was the first born and it was reported on the TV stations or newspapers at the time? She said yes, but it was because the first baby born in the city published in the newspaper that day was born at 0:30. It was not me, but the child of a person whose family was somewhat powerful in the city.
I said that’s why you are so worried about it? My mother said yes, not for the so-called first place, but to restore the truth.
